title: site.config.json
description: The project's identity. Every script and page reads it from here.

siteUrl.description: The site address without a trailing slash. A host on .example means the address is not decided yet.

verification.description: Optional site-ownership tokens for search engines, written as meta tags on the home page.

google.description: The content value of Google Search Console's HTML tag (google-site-verification).

bing.description: The content value of Bing Webmaster Tools' HTML tag (msvalidate.01).
